findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical in appearance to light and the probe reports color-scheme normal with black text; no user-driven dark theme.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Animation continues when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the probe still found at least 30 running ld_De animations, each 750 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable auto-advance and remove or shorten non-essential animations inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: State and route transitions do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM/CSS inspection of the homepage. No view-transition rules were present in captured CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document and cross-document View Transitions for meaningful state changes, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Persistent header chrome does not adapt to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM/CSS inspection of the homepage. The large header remains static and no scroll-state query or shrinking-header behavior was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state/container queries or a lightweight declarative shrinking-header pattern.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior relies on viewport breakpoints rather than component containers.
findings.evidence: Probe found doctype html, lang en-US, one H1, ordered H1/H2/H3 headings, 57 visible controls, visible focus, and 11 potentially unnamed focusable elements including product-price divs. The structure probe found zero CSSContainerRule entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reused merchandising cards and header components.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance is far outside good Core Web Vitals targets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured performance 0.38, LCP 19.6 s, FCP 6.3 s, TBT 820 ms and Speed Index 8.6 s; trace measured 5 long tasks and 380.83 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP element, reduce JavaScript, and break up long tasks; verify against field and lab CWV.

findings.summary: Heavy scripting blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured performance 0.38, LCP 19.6 s, FCP 6.3 s, TBT 820 ms and Speed Index 8.6 s; trace measured 5 long tasks and 380.83 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Break long tasks, schedule non-critical work by priority, and defer analytics and merchandising hydration.

findings.summary: The page makes an excessive number of requests and delivers a large script payload.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 422 requests and 3,629,747 transferred bytes, including 266 scripts (2,929,970 bytes) and 390 third-party requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical dependency chains, defer non-critical requests, and preload only genuinely critical assets.

findings.summary: JavaScript dominates the transfer budget.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 422 requests and 3,629,747 transferred bytes, including 266 scripts (2,929,970 bytes) and 390 third-party requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Use route-level code splitting and coverage analysis to remove unused and duplicate bundles and delay third parties.

findings.summary: Focusable elements include unnamed links and product-price containers.
findings.evidence: Probe found doctype html, lang en-US, one H1, ordered H1/H2/H3 headings, 57 visible controls, visible focus, and 11 potentially unnamed focusable elements including product-price divs. Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.97; link-name failed for one link while contrast, labels, button names and heading order passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every focusable element a meaningful accessible name; remove tabindex from non-interactive price wrappers.

findings.summary: The page logs many browser errors during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 17 browser-console error entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve runtime/network errors and prevent expected failures from being emitted as console errors.

findings.summary: Images are frequently oversized or delivered in legacy formats.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 8 oversized images, 19 legacy-format images, 3 without srcset and 1 missing alt; all had dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP variants at display-appropriate sizes and provide complete alt text.

findings.summary: The cold load emits inspector-visible browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 17 browser-console error entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit the 17 Lighthouse console-error entries, remove deprecated/broken integrations, and keep third-party failures contained.

findings.summary: Cookie and response-header hardening is incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, CSP, HSTS, frame protections and Permissions-Policy are present, but X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are absent. Cookie audit found 16 cookies reported without Secure and several SameSite=None; vtc lasts 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on every HTTPS cookie, review SameSite=None use, and add nosniff and an explicit Referrer-Policy.

findings.summary: The homepage has a large third-party and tracking footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found seven third-party origins and known Google advertising and Criteo endpoints. HAR recorded 422 requests and 3,629,747 transferred bytes, including 266 scripts (2,929,970 bytes) and 390 third-party requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize, batch, consent-gate and defer analytics/advertising requests; remove vendors without demonstrated user value.

findings.summary: Defensive policy coverage has material gaps.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, CSP, HSTS, frame protections and Permissions-Policy are present, but X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are absent. The CSP only declares frame-ancestors and does not constrain script sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a fuller nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff and Referrer-Policy, then review Trusted Types for the XSS-sensitive app.

findings.summary: Layout CSS is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: DOM declares lang=en-US, but rendered CSS contains extensive physical left/right declarations and no document dir.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer logical inline/block properties and set direction intentionally for localized document variants.

findings.summary: The primary search input disables browser autocomplete.
findings.evidence: The only accessible homepage input is search with autocomplete="off"; search/product/account flows could not be exercised through the bot wall.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow useful search suggestions/history where privacy policy permits; use appropriate autocomplete tokens in account and checkout forms.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and misses modern formats.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 8 oversized images, 19 legacy-format images, 3 without srcset and 1 missing alt; all had dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP sources and right-size each merchandising image to its rendered slot.

findings.summary: The homepage performs disproportionate scripting and background requests.
findings.evidence: HAR and image evidence show 3.63 MB/422 requests, 2.93 MB script, 19 legacy images and 390 requests classified third-party.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer or eliminate non-visible work, batch analytics, and load below-fold merchandising only near the viewport.

findings.summary: Third-party requests dominate the network budget.
findings.evidence: HAR and image evidence show 3.63 MB/422 requests, 2.93 MB script, 19 legacy images and 390 requests classified third-party.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a third-party budget, lazy-load non-essential vendors, and remove duplicate measurement paths.

findings.summary: A major commerce flow exposes no structured agent actions.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found two JSON-LD blocks but no WebMCP surface and no on-device inference API usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose narrowly scoped, confirmable product-search, cart and order-status tools through agentic forms/WebMCP when the platform policy allows.

findings.summary: The initial homepage JavaScript heap is disproportionately large.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap contained 947,685 nodes, 63,515 closures and 57.86 MB self size on a single homepage view.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce hydrated component count, closures and retained application state; lazy-hydrate below-fold experiences.
